items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: We went there with King Oliver's Nine Kings.

ctx.x: Then I come back again to the West Coast in 20, 21, no, 20, out to Frisco, to the Deluxe.

What band were you with then? King Oliver. King Oliver. King Oliver. King Oliver. King Oliver. King Oliver's Nine Kings. There were nine pieces? Nine. It's a pretty big band, huh? Well, we had Jimmy Ballard played violin and tempo for Oakland to What band were you with then? King Oliver. We went there with King Oliver's Nine Kings. There were nine pieces?
There were nine. It's a pretty big band, huh?

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: We played down there with them. That was King Oliver's group, I was working see?

ctx.x: When I left there, we come on down to Los Angeles, to play with Jelly Roll of a Friday and -- of a Saturday and Sunday. At Leek's Lake (Unintelligible). He used to run dances there. We played down there with them. That was King Oliver's group, I was working see?

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Then Joe left and come join us at there. Then I turned the band over to Joe.

ctx.x: Well, then when did you go to Royal Garden? Was that before or after the uh-

Oh, no. Joe went over to Royal Garden and I was at the Dreamland. Then Joe left and come join us at there. Then I turned the band over to Joe. See? At the Dreamland. Then we left the Dreamland to come to the Pecola Dance Hall on Market Street.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We had Lil Hardin on piano. We had Johnny Dotson on Clionet. Joe Oliver on trumpet. Nora Dutre on trombone. Uh, we had, uh, Jimmy Polar on violin. Uh, we had a band. And I was on the bass.

ctx.x: They fired Jimmy Polar. Oh yeah. I remember that. You see, I'll give you the lineup of the band we left fairly well with. We had, uh, we think from the piano. We had Lil Hardin on piano. We had Johnny Dotson on Clionet. Joe Oliver on trumpet. Nora Dutre on trombone. Uh, we had, uh, Jimmy Polar on violin. Uh, we had a band. And I was on the bass. Ram was on the drums. Okay. Then, they want to turn this boy loose, give him a note. Didn't give him no notice. Just fired him.
